treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — student proficiency rate using standardized assessment system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — student proficiency rate measured quarterly. Target: 70% proficiency in core subjects. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against NAEP achievement level benchmarks. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — student proficiency rate trending toward 80% proficiency. Escalate if <60% proficiency floor. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using NAEP Assessment Framework. Report to Minister of Education.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a curriculum design and standards specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign.
